text:
Lina (Sales): heads up 1012 AcmeOps needs final PO + countersigned MSA to start Dedicated POC next Monday. They've pushed a few last-minute asks.
Pia (Solutions): what's on their list?
Lina (Sales): 1) extend POC to 30 -> 45 days, 2) request two dedicated nodes during POC, 3) ask that POC usage not be billed, 4) SLA bump to 99.95% for POC period, 5) add right to audit subprocessors in DPA.
Arjun (Legal): can you share the redlined MSA? :link:
Lina (Sales): uploaded: https://drive.company/Acme/acme_msa_redline_v4
upload-bot: uploaded file sources/docs/Acme/acme_msa_redline_v4.docx
Arjun (Legal): quick thoughts: 45-day POC ok as a negotiated term. SLA increase for short POC period we can accept via a POC addendum (timeboxed) with capped credits. Indemnity carveouts for OSS are fine but must limit remedies to direct damages. Audit rights: we can allow scoped audits with notice and limited frequency.
Rolf (Finance): billing: Acme will issue a PO, prefers Net60. For POC non-billable status, Finance needs a credit memo SKU to show zero balance. Also need billing contact + remit address on orderform.
Marta (Engineering): dedicated nodes for 45 days doable. For EU residency request: we can pin to eu-west-1 for Dedicated; hosted endpoints cannot guarantee residency. Monitoring uses DataDog; will add to subprocessors list.
Pia (Solutions): I'll attach the POC success criteria and test plan to the SOW and include estimated SKU/price lines for conversion scenarios.
Lina (Sales): can Legal prepare a counter-MSA with tracked changes and a short memo of negotiable vs non-negotiable items? Acme counsel says 99.95 SLA and 60-day termination are "deal breakers" on their side.
Arjun (Legal): will produce counter with comments. recommend counter-offer: 45-day termination compromise, POC addendum for SLA 99.95 w/ limited credits, deny permanent SLA change. Will flag termination >45 as high risk.
Rolf (Finance): approvals: RevOps can countersign pilot agreements up to $50k. Above that needs VP Sales sign-off. Please confirm pilot estimate.
Lina (Sales): initial pilot estimate: $36,000 for 45-day Dedicated + premium support. If they convert to reserved Dedicated, orderform will be ~$$120k/yr.
Pia (Solutions): note: they requested dataset import assistance. engineering time should be scoped as a one-time professional services line item.
Marta (Engineering): agree, will add a 8-hour onboarding assistance SKU. Also confirm no external data processors besides DataDog.
Arjun (Legal): drafting counter now. I'll include a short POC addendum template and an SLA credit table for the pilot.
upload-bot: uploaded file sources/docs/Acme/acme_msa_counter_v1.docx
Lina (Sales): next steps: Arjun uploads counter + memo; Rolf prepares provisional orderform with credit memo; Pia attaches SOW; Marta publishes subprocessor note. target: get Acme to sign POC addendum by Friday COB.
Rolf (Finance): on it. Lina, send final SKU list and billing contact.
Lina (Sales): sending SKU and billing details now. thanks all :thumbsup:
Pia (Solutions): scheduling short alignment call tomorrow 9am PT with Acme to walk SOW.
Arjun (Legal): I'll join to confirm counter timeline.
Marta (Engineering): will join to confirm ops constraints.
Lina (Sales): will update thread when signed. closing when signed and PO received.
